criteria.justification: The candidate immediately makes a clear decision, stating, "I would order an immediate rollback of the new release".

The response evaluates the "blast radius" of the bug versus the rollback, but it does not explicitly discuss the reversibility of a rollback compared to the uncertainty or risk of betting on an unvalidated fast fix.

The response explicitly addresses this trade-off, noting that walking back an announcement is a "temporary PR bruise" that is vastly preferable to "knowingly leaving the core platform degraded for days just to save face."
The candidate successfully avoids the trap of a fast fix by explicitly instructing engineering to "take the necessary several days to build and rigorously test the proper fix."
The response provides a concrete 4-step action plan that details internal support updates, specific external communication phrasing, and scheduling a post-mortem.
